# interfere_workspace (Data Source)

Look up an existing workspace without managing its lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "interfere_workspace" "team" {
  workspace_slug = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `data_residency_location` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
